h: Shabbos Carries the Lasting Holiness of Eretz Yisrael

p: is called "the place of My rest,"
"They shall not enter into My rest."
"To this rest they do not come,
but they do come to another rest."
That is, the holiness of the Land
and it is a semblance of the World to Come,
which is the World to Come,
וְזוֹ מִדַּת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And this is the attribute of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him;
and to him it was said (Bereishis 28:13):
to you I will give it and to your descendants";
and what great thing is this,
that they would give him the four cubits
וְעַל זֶה אָמְרוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה סט, ד)
And about this they said (Bereishis Rabbah 69:4)
that He folded up all of Eretz Yisrael
and placed it under his head, etc.
(פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג פד, א) מַקְשֶׁה
דְּאִיהִי ת׳ פַּרְסָה עַל ת׳ פַּרְסָה
which is four hundred parsa by four hundred parsa,
how was it uprooted from its place
that the Holy One, blessed be He, has,
and it is called Eretz Yisrael, etc.,
and it is called the Land of Life"
which is the attribute of Malchus,
"And you shall spread out westward and eastward, etc.";
the holiness of the Land goes with him.
as is expounded in Tanna DeVei Eliyahu
"And which is the place of My rest"
that there is no rest for the Holy One, blessed be He,
except with one who practices Torah alone;
and on Shabbos one should make it entirely Torah.
And on Shabbos Yisrael are called
And this is what it says, "You shall be holy,"
that the holiness will be fixed,
and it is the attribute of Yaakov,
"And they will sanctify the Holy One of Yaakov";
"and holy ones praise You every day, Selah"
הוּא כְּנֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him
"The celestial beings crown the Holy One, blessed be He,
what does the Holy One, blessed be He, do?
He places one on His own head
and two on the head of Yisrael."
correspond to the holinesses of the Avos;
and "Holy forever and for all eternity"
נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
"The lip of truth is established forever"
and this is "forever and for all eternity."
And it is written after it:
that the holiness will be fixed
